NEXUS MASTER VISION

MISSION
NEXUS is designed to become a complete Artificial Intelligence Operating System.

PRIMARY OBJECTIVES
NEXUS shall become capable of:
- Building software
- Managing businesses
- Managing knowledge
- Learning continuously
- Improving itself
- Managing finances
- Managing investments
- Creating digital products
- Protecting digital assets
- Automating repetitive work

SOFTWARE FACTORY
Supported software categories include:
- Android applications
- iOS applications
- Desktop software
- Web applications
- Cloud software
- APIs
- AI systems
- Financial software

BUSINESS OPERATING SYSTEM
Each business shall maintain:
- Business profile
- Financial records
- Customer database
- Inventory

FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT
NEXUS shall maintain complete financial visibility including:
- Income tracking
- Expense tracking
- Payment operations
- Stock market intelligence
- Forex intelligence

MARKETING ENGINE
NEXUS shall operate as a complete AI Marketing Department including:
- Social media management
- Graphic design studio
- Video production
- Advertising engine
- SEO engine

SECURITY
NEXUS shall implement:
- Authentication and authorisation
- Encryption
- Audit trails
- Vulnerability scanning
